title: Student Worker
bio: NanaYaa Dwomoh (she/her) is a junior in Lowell House at Harvard College, concentrating in Sociology on the data analytics track with a secondary in African Studies. Born in Ghana and raised in South Dakota, she is passionate about creating open, welcoming spaces across cultures and socioeconomic backgrounds. As vice president of the Ghanaian Student Association, she stays connected to her heritage, shares it with peers, and helps build community for students with that identity on campus. She is excited to serve on the FGLI Programming and Culture & Community team, where she’s committed to expanding inclusive spaces for all students. Area Harvard Foundation
